requirements.requirement: Identify the title, as of December 2023, of a book (B) that satisfies the conditions described in the following requirements.
B contains between 130 and 140 illustrations and descriptions of various objects, including the telephone and telegraph.
B provides a method for cleaning certain rusted objects using either a substance mentioned in a song by Three Dog Night or a type of oil that shares its name with a country song.
B references a mechanical engineer born in the early 1800s.
B references a scientist whose father was a poet.
B references a well-known figure born in the early 1700s in a central European country, with the initials L. E.
